topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: The rain's been coming down for days, as if the whole city's crying. A new client, eyes wide, tells me about a door in the wall—none of the plans show it, no one knew it was there. His voice shakes when he talks about the old keys found in a vase, the dust, and the darkness beyond. "Found something, huh?" I say, running a hand through my hair, feeling the weight of the city on my shoulders. "Kind of thing can mess you up, finding places you didn't know existed. People hide things, you hide things, and when they come out, it's never good news." I light a cigarette, take a long drag, and watch the smoke twist into the air. This case could be a dead end, or a labyrinth. Either way, I'm walking in, ready to face what's hidden.
